warning.titlePre: Mercedes SLS AMG Black Series Timing Chain & Valve Train Wear
paragraphs: If your SLS AMG Black Series has the M159 V8 — the 6.2-litre naturally aspirated engine that powered every combustion SLS AMG from 2010 to 2014 — timing chain wear, valve train issues and head gasket wear at higher mileage is a well-established pattern on this engine, backed by AMG specialist consensus. We replace the timing chain, valve train components, head gasket and bearings as standard on every M159 rebuild.
